operations.x-evidence: Catalog publishes the response schema but no weight. Read-only probes 2026-10-03 (production dapi.binance.com and demo-dapi): no weight header, X-MBX-USED-WEIGHT-1M unchanged across calls (0 IP weight); live arrays also carry disclaimer and a nullable updateTime.

Integration notice C.5 names the conditional vocabulary; Authorized demo probe 2026-10-03 (demo-dapi.binance.com, issue #11): STOP_MARKET SELL accepted (HTTP 200, full acknowledgment observed); headers report one slot on X-MBX-ORDER-COUNT-10S/-1M and no IP weight (sentinel -1).

Integration notice C.5 (cancel by algoId or clientAlgoId); Authorized demo probe 2026-10-03 (demo-dapi.binance.com, issue #11): DELETE by clientAlgoId without symbol accepted (HTTP 200, {algoId, clientAlgoId, code, msg} observed); X-MBX-USED-WEIGHT-1M increased by exactly 1.

Integration notice C.5; Authorized demo probe 2026-10-03 (demo-dapi.binance.com, issue #11): HTTP 200 with and without symbol; X-MBX-USED-WEIGHT-1M increased by 1 per symbol-scoped call and 40 per unscoped call; item shape observed live.
